thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] consumption-aggregate anomaly detected for prod/ingest-pipeline. consumption_rate deviation > 35% vs 1h baseline. Overages triggered for ~12 accounts. Pager severity: P2. See: https://alerts.redwood.ai/INC-6151 :eyes:
Jordan: oncall here, looking. Which pipeline? any consumer lag? I'll take lead. :handshake:
Alex: I see a gap at the aggregation stage starting 2024-11-05T03:14Z. Query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE ts BETWEEN '2024-11-05T03:10Z' AND '2024-11-05T03:20Z' GROUP BY minute;` shows drop to ~60% of expected at 03:14Z.
Priya: billing-ops reporting automated overage emails sent to 8 customers so far. We need scope + whether charges hit invoices. Holding credits for now but need list.
Jordan: OK muting overage-email alert channel for the next 45m. @Priya please hold any charge runs. I'm adding —suppress-overage-emails=true to the alert policy.
ops-bot: `action: mute channel #billing-alerts for 45m (by Jordan)`
Liam: runtime telemetry shows kafka-consumer-lag on consumer group `usage-agg` spiked at 03:13Z to 1200 msgs. consumer-metrics: `lag:1200, processing-rate: 240/s (baseline 900/s)` — looks like downstream worker starvation after a recent rollout.
Alex: adding log snippet from aggregator:
```
2024-11-05T03:12:58Z WARN worker-5: backlog exceed threshold: queue_size=512, max_workers=4
2024-11-05T03:14:07Z ERROR agg-batch: failed to flush window id=98765 reason=oom
2024-11-05T03:14:12Z INFO retrying batch id=98765
```
Maria: support: two customers opened tickets complaining about spikes/overages (cust: OwlPay, NeonDesk). They're asking if they've been charged.
Priya: confirmed automated emails included provisional overage flag, not final invoice charges. No invoices posted yet. But we should still notify affected accounts with an explanation and offer hold/credit.
Jordan: immediate mitigations:
- pause new overage emails (done)
- increase `usage-agg` consumer replicas from 4 -> 8 (rolling scale) to catch up
- trigger backfill job for missing windows `backfill --from 2024-11-05T03:10Z --to 2024-11-05T03:20Z --priority=high`
Alex: I can kick the backfill. Running: `./tools/backfill --consumer usage-agg --window 2024-11-05T03:10Z/2024-11-05T03:20Z &`
Liam: note: the recent runtime release 2024.11.04 introduced a change to GC thresholds that might reduce worker throughput under memory pressure — rolling it back on a test node now.
Priya: please add a CSV of affected account ids & email states. I'll prep credit playbook. Also advise comms tone.
Jordan: creating incident bridge: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/INC-6151 — join if you need to speak live. If I don't have resolution in 30m I'll escalate to SRE leads.
Alex: backfill started. Initial progress: 10% complete, estimated catch-up 22m at current throughput.
ops-bot: `runbook update: suppressed overage-email alert, backfill job started, scaled usage-agg replicas.`
incident-bot: investigation note added: suspected cause = consumer starvation after runtime GC regression; mitigation = scale + backfill + rollback test.
Maria: support update: Told OwlPay & NeonDesk we are investigating and paused billing flow; they want ETA and temporary credit. They appreciated quick reply.
Jordan: status @ 03:40Z: backfill at 85%, consumer lag down to 120 msgs, processing-rate 880/s. Starting to see token counts reconcile in the aggregator.
Alex: reconciled counts for windows 03:10-03:20: delta reduced from -42% to -2% after backfill. Logs show final flush success for batch id=98765 at 03:41:12Z.
Priya: good — stop suppression in 10m but hold final invoice runs until 06:00Z UTC. I'll draft comms and credit list.
Liam: rollback test on staging showed the GC threshold change reintroduced the throughput drop; plan: revert runtime change in next 2 deploy slots, patch will be in canary at 04:10Z.
Jordan: re-enabling alerts now with higher noise threshold to avoid chatter. @Priya confirm if we should re-send corrected emails or separate follow-up.
Priya: we'll send a follow-up explaining transient anomaly + that charges were held; offer one-time credit where provisional flags were sent. I'll coordinate with finance.
Maria: support updated tickets; customers OK with credit notice and ETA for postmortem.
Jordan: final status @ 04:55Z: incident mitigated, consumers scaled, backfill complete, runtime change scheduled for rollback, overage emails suppressed then re-enabled in controlled mode. No invoices charged. Closing bridge in 10.
incident-bot: Incident INC-6151 status -> Resolved (mitigated). Tags: cause:runtime-gc-regression, action:scale+backfill+rollback, cust-impact:provisional-email-only, credits-pending.
Priya: postmortem: I'll own billing-impact section. Jordan please add timeline + technical root cause. We'll circulate draft tomorrow.
Jordan: acknowledged. Thanks everyone — great coordination. :thumbsup:
